name: Trusted AI Safety Expert

fee.note: Sold only as a training + exam bundle (no exam-only option): the self-paced course with one year of access, the study guide and an exam token with two attempts valid for two years. Instructor-led options are listed on CSA's training schedule.

exam.format: Exam-based certificate. 60 multiple-choice questions (6 per module), 120 minutes, 80% to pass. Open book, online and unproctored on CSA Exams, taken any time after purchase without scheduling. No exam-only purchase.

discounts.text: CSA offers corporate team-training discounts, and CSA corporate members get training benefits they can use on TAISE; terms on request.

access.retake: The bundle's exam token includes two attempts, valid two years and extendable six months at a time on request, with no waiting period between them; extra attempts are requested from CSA support.
access.accommodations: Testing accommodations, including extra time for candidates whose first language is not English, are requested from CSA support and considered case by case.

scope: AI architecture, use cases, ethics, lifecycle threats, governance, security and data privacy.
ai_policy: CSA describes the exam as open book, online and unproctored; check the CSA Exams rules before using any tool.
caveats: The two-year validity CSA lists applies to the exam token and its two attempts, not to the certificate; the TAISE page and prep-kit FAQ read for this entry give no certificate expiry.
